text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with eight quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: Between January 2022 and June 2023, the Kestrel Valley Playgroup Network expanded from 14 to thirty-one weekly sessions across six parishes. Attendance rose by 42 percent, though the evaluation team did not find a matching improvement in language scores for children under two. Facilitators attributed this to irregular attendance rather than weak materials. No site reported a shortage of picture books after the March 2022 distribution. Caregivers said they valued the sessions mainly for the chance to meet other parents. The team recommends that the second phase should never rely on a single volunteer per site, and that each group keep at least three trained facilitators by December 2023.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to Session 4 of the Mwangaza Village Savings and Loan guide. Each group should have between fifteen and 25 members, and every member must buy at least one share at each weekly meeting. The share price is fixed at the first meeting and is never changed during a cycle of 12 months. Volunteers should not hold the cash box themselves; it stays with a member chosen by the group, and the three keys go to three different people. If a member cannot attend, she may send a relative, but she cannot send her loan repayment by text message. Records must be read aloud so that nobody is confused about the balance.

passages.source_passage: Board members will recall that the Sahel Bridge cash transfer reached 3,200 households by the end of the 2023 lean season, against a target of 3,000. Each household received 45 dollars a month for six months. Payment delays were not a major problem, since 91 percent of transfers arrived within two days of the scheduled date. However, the monitoring team did not find evidence that the transfers reduced school absence, and we have no data yet on child weight. Staff will not request additional funding before the September review. The finance committee has asked for a short note on mobile money fees by 15 October.

passages.source_passage: The Harbourside Vocational Centre opened in 2016 and has since trained roughly 1,800 young people in welding, tailoring and solar installation. Unemployment among 18 to 24 year olds in the district stands at 38 percent, nearly double the national figure. Most graduates do not find formal work within a year, because local employers rarely advertise vacancies and many applicants lack references. The centre has never charged tuition fees, but it has also not offered placement support beyond a two-week internship. This proposal seeks to fund a three-year employer liaison team so that every trainee leaves with at least one signed work placement.

passages.source_passage: At the midpoint of the Riverbend Family Tracing and Foster Care Service, 212 children had been reunified with relatives and 64 placed with foster families, against targets of 250 and 80. Reunification took a median of 117 days. The evaluation did not identify any case in which a child was placed without a home assessment, but eleven files lacked a signed consent form. Foster carers reported that monthly stipends were not always paid on time. Social workers carry an average of 38 cases each, which is well above the recommended maximum of 25. No child was reported missing from a placement in 2023.

passages.source_passage: This module prepares community health workers in Nyamwezi District to visit households during the first 28 days after birth. Each worker should aim to make three visits to every newborn, at day 3, day 7 and day 28. Do not weigh a baby on a cold surface, and never give a baby water before six months of age. If a newborn has a fever or is feeding poorly, refer the family to the clinic the same day; do not wait for the next scheduled visit. Workers who complete the 5-day course receive a certificate, but the certificate is not a licence to prescribe medicine. Practise each step with a doll twice before your first real visit.

passages.source_passage: The Lakeshore Community Counselling Service saw 640 new clients in the first half of 2024, a rise of nearly one fifth on the same period last year. Median waiting time fell from nine weeks to four. We did not meet our target of training 30 lay counsellors, as only 22 completed supervision. No client has been turned away for inability to pay, although the sliding fee scale was not reviewed this year. Follow-up calls found that 73 percent of clients felt less isolated after six sessions. The committee is asked to approve a pilot of evening sessions, which will not begin before March 2025.

passages.source_passage: During 2023 the Tidewatch Coastal Early-Warning Programme installed 18 new siren posts and trained 410 volunteer wardens in 27 fishing villages. Two cyclone alerts were issued, and in both cases every village received the warning at least four hours before landfall. Evacuation drills were not completed in three villages because road repairs were unfinished. We have not yet verified whether households with no mobile phone received the message from a neighbour. The programme did not exceed its budget, spending 96 percent of the 240,000 dollar grant. The remaining balance will be used to repair two sirens that failed during the October test.

passages.source_passage: This guide helps volunteer mentors support scholarship girls in the Sierra Verde programme, which covers fees for 350 students in grades 7 to 11. Meet each girl at least once a month, and keep a short note of what you discussed. Do not promise a girl anything the programme cannot deliver, such as a new laptop or extra funds.
